evals.prompt: Our Code App is slow in production but we have no visibility. How do we set up monitoring?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends Application Insights integration for the Code App, including custom telemetry in the hooks layer, performance marks, and user session tracking.
expectations: Agent recommends integrating Application Insights using the @microsoft/applicationinsights-web SDK
Agent specifies using a connection string (not instrumentation key, which is deprecated)
Agent recommends custom telemetry events in the hooks layer (e.g., data fetch durations, user actions)
Agent recommends performance marks to measure component render times and data load times
Agent recommends enabling Managed Environments on the production environment for platform-level telemetry export
Agent suggests one Application Insights instance per environment (not shared across environments)
Agent may recommend React error boundaries integrated with App Insights for unhandled error tracking
Agent may suggest creating alert rules for slow response times or error rate spikes

evals.prompt: Cloud flows are failing intermittently and we only find out when users complain. How do we set up proactive monitoring?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends Power Automate analytics, a custom error notification flow, Application Insights for critical flows, and an alerting dashboard.
expectations: Agent recommends the Automation Center dashboard for centralized flow monitoring
Agent recommends enabling Application Insights export via Managed Environments for flow telemetry
Agent suggests creating a dedicated error notification flow that triggers on flow failures and sends alerts (e.g., Teams notification or email)
Agent recommends configuring alert rules in Application Insights for failure rate thresholds
Agent may suggest building a monitoring dashboard (Azure Dashboard or Power BI) for flow health visibility
Agent does NOT recommend relying solely on users reporting failures as a monitoring strategy
Agent may mention KQL queries for analyzing flow failure patterns in Application Insights
